description.narrative:
The Mekong programme follows ERIs strategic plan 2025-2029, and aims to contribute to the following regional goals:
1. Community Empowerment for Meaningful Leadership, Influence, and Inclusion Frontline and Indigenous communities increasingly drive, influence, and meaningfully participate in development project decision-making that affects their land, environment, and community.
2. Increased Accountability and Access to Remedy States, corporations, and international finance institutions are pressured to implement practices that respect human and environmental rights and prevent climate abuses, and communities have improved access to remedies when violations occur.
3. Legal Frameworks for Environmental and Human Rights Protection Strengthen laws, standards, and policies for the protection of the environmental and human rights of frontline and Indigenous communities and environmental and human rights defenders in the Mekong region.
4. Environmental and Human Rights Defenders Safety, Security, and Well-Being Environmental and human rights defenders in the region are able to operate safely and securely as they work to prevent, reduce, and obtain remedy for environmental harms and rights abuses.
